name: RPS Flag Hunt
description: Print the 7 × 6 board once and choose two teams in distinct colors. Each team plate makes one team from 14 bodies and 14 keyed heads. Choose the spiky-haired or swept-haired design and test-fit one body and head before printing the team. Print the board seats up and the pieces upright. Use PLA at 100% scale with a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, and supports off. Stand each piece with its rear role symbol facing its owner. Store the game in the box: the figures lie in two holder bars, and the larger box board is a sliding lid.
